method: Per error class, the samples whose golden label reason (agent panel + verifier on the full source, Nghiệp-approved, fixture 1.1.0) cites a writer error of that class. meta_cut is from a direct read of all 50 seo_meta values by the S248 lane (a meta ending on a dangling list item or a modifier without its noun), because labels cite a cut meta only when it mattered for the grade. Labels are not exhaustive: a code hit on a sample outside a class is adjudicated by hand (real but unlabelled vs false alarm), see README.

classes.day_structure: itinerary day blocks contradict the source (sub-day split, extra/missing/duplicate day, mid-trip departure)
classes.number: a figure that is invented, wrong, or bound to the wrong noun (digits, words or numerals)
classes.name: a proper name that is invented, misspelt or applied to the wrong place
classes.inclusion: the page says an item/service is included or provided that the source excludes or never offers
classes.semantic_other: invented promises, directions, timings, scope or background stated as tour fact (panel-only)
